integrity.claim_type: analytical theorem with exact finite-dimensional norm reduction and sharp asymptotic expansion
integrity.reproducibility: Companion verify.py is executable with Python 3 standard library and supplements the proof.

scientific_limitations: The exact formula assumes the unweighted graph K_{2,...,2} with at least three parts and uses its adjacency matrix as Dirac operator.
The adjacent class is an explicit uniquely attained one-variable algebraic minimum; a uniform closed radical is not claimed.
The finite calculations validate only tested dimensions, not the full theorem, whose proof is analytic.
Independent mathematical audit has not been performed; equivalent treatments under other formulations remain a literature risk.
title: Sharp adjacency–Dirac distances on cross-polytope graphs
